dialog: Let's see what these surface dwellers are really about.
Sorry/ but you'll have to keep me company for a bit/
Hold up/ I've got a GREAT present for you!
Time for a little payback.
Hey now/ let me have some fun too!
You've flown straight into my web/ little fly!
Let me show you how we do things underground!
No where to hide!
You're about to witness the terror of a tsuchigumo!
Out of my way!
Undergrounders like us are known for our power.\n　Care for a demonstration?
You gotta do/ what you gotta do.
I'll bring the web to you!
I'll tangle you right up!
I don't let my prey escape!
There you are!
Capture Web!
Escape this if you can!
Gotcha!
There's no escaping this miasma!
Take this!
Breathe in/ the miasma of disorder!
Fall ill/ and perish!
See if you can escape the threads of pestilence!
Uryaaah!
This thread is merciless!
Eat it!
Now I'LL take a bite.
Let's go for a swing!
Tenderize the meat first...
Then bottom's up!
I'll gobble you right up!
Swing/ swing!
Dinner time.
Let's go/ Kisume!
Sure thing! Wait/ where'd you...
Sure thing! Wait/ where'd you...\n　Wah!
Souls of the damned/ full burn!
Spin! Me! Round!
Bucket Cannon...!
Attaaa—
Attaaa—WHY'S THIS SO FAAAAST?!
Ouch!
Fine then...
Fine then... FIRE!
Please don't drop me!
Nice improv/ Kisume.
Ready when you are/ Kisume!
Yep/ I'm read—
Yep/ I'm read—Hyah!
Up you go!
Woohoo!
This one blow will knock you...!
Straight to hell—
Straight to hell—WHY'M I GOING TOOO?!
Ouch!
How about...
Liftoff!
Nice catch/ Yamame!
S'what trust exercises are all about.
Clench those teeth/ Kisume!
You got it/ coach!
You got it/ coach!\n　Whoa!
I'll bet it all on this pitch!
We're heading for finals!
This is our legendary...!
First! Pitch!
First! Pitch!\n　WHAT EVEN IS THIS JOOOOKE?!
ACHOO!
But even so...
But even so... I won't falter!
How was that/ my magic ball?
...You're a pretty wild pitcher/ Yamame.
I'm pretty good at waiting/ you know.
I wouldn't say I could do this ALL day/ but...
Pretty rude way to fight a spider...
C'mon/ come a little closer...
Even us Underworlders know how to pay back a debt.
I'm always ready to help.
Leave the leftovers to me!
Gotta let others have their fun first sometimes.
I'll infect that one.
I won't let you have your way!
I was just in the mood/ don't overthink it.
My threads will stop them!
I'm no diversion/ I'm the whole damn show!
I'll pin them down!
Leave the setup to me!
We're in this together!
Take care of them for me!
Keep your distance if you don't want webs in your mouth!
I'll web them right up!
Come on partner/ I'm counting on you here!
Let's have some fun with this!
Let's team up and take them down!
You'll regret beating up Kisume!
You did great/ Kisume.
Kisume/ leave the rest to me.
Don't let your guard down just because your bucket's sturdy!
You've got a lot of blind spots in there/ huh...
Here's a get-well present/ Kisume!
I'll pin them down/ Kisume!
Let's do this/ Kisume!
Let's work together on this/ Kisume!
Let's show them the power of the Underworld/ Kisume!
Come on Kisume/ I'm counting on you here!
Let's have some fun with this/ Kisume!
Kisume/ let's team up and take them down!
Parsee... I'll pay them back double for you!
I'll lend you a hand/ Parsee!
I'll finish them off/ Parsee!
Stop being jealous and focus!
Where's your head at/ Parsee?!
Here's a get-well present/ Parsee!
I'll pin them down/ Parsee!
Let's do this/ Parsee!
Let's work together on this/ Parsee!
Let's show them the power of the Underworld/ Parsee!
Come on Parsee/ I'm counting on you here!
Let's have some fun with this/ Parsee!
Parsee/ let's team up and take them down!
Yuugi... I'll pay them back double for you!
It's unlike you to not finish your plate.
You don't mind if I finish them off/ do you?
I suppose even you need help sometimes.
You're being a bit TOO fair/ I think.
Here's a get-well present/ Yuugi!
I'll pin them down/ Yuugi!
Let's do this/ Yuugi!
Let's work together on this/ Yuugi!
Let's show them the power of the Underworld/ Yuugi!
Come on Yuugi/ I'm counting on you here!
Let's have some fun with this/ Yuugi!
Yuugi/ let's team up and take them down!
What's the Queen of Insects doing/ sacrificing herself like that?!
Listen/ you wanna say we're in the same class?\n　Then do a better job next time.
Ugh/ fine. I'll help out.
You are SUCH a pain in my ass...
Quit dawdling!
Can't believe I'm stuck with you...
Listen/ you wanna say we're in the same class?\n　Then you'd better do a good job with this!
You'd better not mess this up!
I'm bothering to help you/ so you'd better finish the job!
Show me what your buddies" can do/ Wriggle.
Let's show them what we're capable of/ Wriggle!
Let's take them down/ Wriggle!
Wriggle/ follow my lead!
My webs make great padding!
I don't even have to take this seriously!
Just gotta make it through this...
Not making this very tough for me.
What a joke.
Lukewarm at best.
You're barely even worth my time.
Not much left in the tank...
Crap! They're way stronger than I expected...
You're gonna regret not finishing me off!
Just down to luck/ now...
You're gonna have a bad time!
I see... So that's how it is.
Damn/ they're fast!
Agh/ they got me...
I'll use my webs!
The battle's far from over!
You're no joke...
Don't stick too close/ or you'll get tangled up.
You'll regret messing with me!
This one's for real...
I won't go down without a fight!
For your sake/ I hope you were holding back.
Yawn.
Try again next time/ kiddo!
Not even close!
What's wrong? Limbs feeling heavy?
Accuracy alone won't cut it!
Aaand there we have it.
Spiders are quicker than you'd think.
Cutting it kinda close there!
Gotten your eyes checked recently?
Not gonna work!
Nope!
So you've come into my parlor!
Caught me a big one!
Guess I let my guard down...
Didn't think I'd be losing like this...
They got me...\n　But they don't know how vengeful I can be.
Crap/ I really screwed this up.\n　Sorry guys/ but I'm taking a breather.
Who'd've thought she'd go so far...
Trust me/ we'd LOVE to hear what you're up to!
Didn't think we'd be implicated in an incident...
Didn't think we'd be implicated in an incident...
Well well/ you've certainly got some heat on you now.
Never thought THIS was how I'd visit the surface...
As a fellow Underworlder/ we've gotta fix our own problems!
C'mere Wriggle. Let's see how tough you really are...
I suppose you've got the pick of the litter up here on the surface.
Let's see what you've got.
Kids on the surface get up to some wild stuff...
You'd best avoid my webs if you wanna keep that pep in your step.
I feel for you/ getting caught up in all this.
Pompous jerks like you are my favorite type of prey.
I don't have time for your crap.
Don't think you can escape a spider's clutches!
I REALLY don't give a crap what your deal is.
Kind of a roundabout way to get your attention/ but here goes...
Hey Koishi! Float your way over here for a bit!
Is this supposed to intimidate me somehow?
I wonder if nightmares can get sick.
I'm gonna wrap you up and throw you in a river!
Hell of a stunt you're pulling here.
So that's what you forced inside of you/ huh?
Ugh/ I can barely stand to look at you.
You come at me/ you'd best not miss.
My diseases are FAR worse than any nightmare you can cook up!
So you CAN learn. Will wonders never cease!
I've got some webs with your name on them!
If you wanna do this/ then let's do it.
My diseases are FAR worse than any nightmare you can cook up!
How many times do we have to teach you this lesson/ old baku?!
I've got some webs with your name on them!
